edits.new:
Then the run names policy version "P1" and prompt version "PR1" as the versions in force

  Scenario: AC15 An answer below the confidence floor is not used (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the INT-23 model stub returns a valid answer with confidence 0.79 against the policy floor 0.80 for a CaseCreated event of the W1J01 synthetic set
    When agent "INTAKE" runs on that event
    Then the run holds status "BELOW_FLOOR" and fallback true
    Then no output reaches a user

  Scenario: AC16 A tool outside the allowed list is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the INT-23 model stub asks for a tool that is not on the allowed list of agent "INTAKE" (fault switch: tool)
    When agent "INTAKE" runs on a CaseCreated event of the W1J01 synthetic set
    Then the tool call is refused and the run holds status "GUARDRAIL_FAILED", check code "TOOL_NOT_ALLOWED" and fallback true

  Scenario: AC17 A second evaluation of the same agent and sample version is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given an evaluation of "INTAKE" on sample "INTAKE-S1" version 1 is RUNNING
    When RW-COE starts another evaluation of "INTAKE" on "INTAKE-S1" version 1 through `POST /api/recovery/agent/v1/admin/agent-evaluations`
    Then the system refuses the request with 409 and MSG-P10-003
    Then one evaluation run stays RUNNING

  Scenario: AC18 A fake for a real service fails the preflight (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a run is configured with a fake for rwb-source-data (P1)
    When the preflight runs
    Then the preflight refuses the run
    Then only INT-23, the clock and the fixtures are stubbed and no assertion is made

  Scenario: AC19 A suite step cannot read a service schema (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the suite is built with no client for a service schema
    When a change adds a client for a service schema and the pipeline scan runs
    Then the pipeline scan fails the change
    Then the suite holds no client for a service schema
